companyDescription: Critical battery minerals · Nevada battery recycling (first positive adjusted gross profit in FY26) + Tonopah Flats lithium refinery in NEPA review · Commerce license to export up to $100M of recycled black mass (Oct 2026) · ~$188M market cap vs a PFS-stage $2.57B after-tax NPV
priceNote: Live $1.32 (+0.4%) on Nov 11, 2026 — down 42% from $2.27 at the Sep 29 report, near the ~$1.29 low it touched Oct 26. Market cap ~$188M (~143M shares). The slide came after the black-mass export license was granted, with no company-specific negative news found. Old Base +44.9% ($3.29) is replaced by a new Base +45% ($1.91) anchored to the live price.
summary: Refresh after a -42% slide since the Sep 29 report. The biggest open risk in that report has resolved in ABAT's favour: in early October the Commerce Department's BIS licensed ABAT to export and sell up to $100M of recycled black mass, after a federal export restriction had forced it to store material on-site. The stock still fell from ~$1.57 (Oct 15) to ~$1.29 (Oct 26) with no company-specific trigger found — momentum selling in a weak small-cap tape, possibly with ATM selling under the $250M shelf filed Sep 18 (not confirmed). Survival is not flagged: FY26 closed with $49.5M cash and zero long-term debt against a $24.2M annual operating burn (~2 years at that pace), but no FY27 Q1 numbers are out yet and the shelf is the funding plan for Tonopah Flats. The next proof point is the Q1 FY2027 print (expected mid-to-late November, not yet scheduled): recycling revenue and the first export-license sales. Measured turbo median return to just after the catalyst is -10.6% (n=69), so prefer the dip zone. Size 2% max.

catalysts.name: Black Mass Export License — First Sales
catalysts.description: BIS approved ABAT's request to export and sell up to $100M of recycled black mass (early Oct 2026), lifting the on-site storage constraint from the federal export restriction. Shares rose ~10% premarket on the news before fading.

catalysts.name: Tonopah Flats NEPA Review
catalysts.description: BLM accepted the Plan of Operations on Sep 8, 2026, moving the lithium refinery into full NEPA environmental review. No single dated milestone.

risks: The stock fell ~42% in six weeks with no company-specific trigger found, including after good news (the export license) — that pattern often means persistent supply, such as ATM selling under the $250M mixed shelf filed Sep 18, 2026. Q1 FY27 filings will show whether shares were sold.

Runway (~2 years at the FY26 burn of $24.2M against $49.5M of cash) is fine for operations but nowhere near enough for the multi-billion-dollar Tonopah Flats build — that will need large equity or project financing at a ~$188M market cap.
Tonopah Flats' $2.57B NPV and 21.8% IRR are pre-feasibility estimates, and the refinery is still in NEPA review.
Federal funding has already been revoked once and reinstated on appeal; critical-minerals policy can change again, including the export-restriction regime the new license sits under.
Analyst coverage is thin (consensus $6 from two analysts) and may be stale; the Q1 FY27 report date is not yet announced.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed hiked 25bp on Sep 16, 2026 (first hike since 2023), and a hot October CPI (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected) has pushed Dec 9 FOMC hike odds to roughly 89–100%, with the 10-year near 4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: October CPI ran hot (headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3%); October PCE on Nov 25 is the next inflation read.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: ABAT's long-term plan depends on raising large amounts of capital for Tonopah Flats; a priced-in December hike and a ~5% 10-year make that capital more expensive and keep small-cap materials names out of favour.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — the company is not forced to raise near term, but its growth case is financing-dependent and the stock is a small cap in a weak tape.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — the export-license risk resolved in ABAT's favour, but the stock fell 42% anyway, which points to supply or dilution until Q1 FY27 shows otherwise. Measured turbo median return from report price to just after the catalyst is -10.6% (n=69), so buying at report price is not the default: prefer $1.15–1.25. ค่าขนม sizing 2%.

postWin.note: ABAT rose ~10% premarket on the black-mass export license (early Oct 2026) and then faded. regulatory_approval in the turbo lane runs in line with the overall lane (+7.1pp vs +7.7, n=23). ABAT's own 52-week range, which included a multi-hundred-percent run on stacked DOE/BLM headlines plus revenue growth, is the guide to the upper bound, not any single event.

th.summary: รีเฟรชหลังราคาร่วง 42% จากรายงาน 29 ก.ย. ความเสี่ยงใหญ่ที่สุดในรายงานก่อนคลี่คลายไปทางบวกแล้ว: ต้นเดือน ต.ค. BIS ของกระทรวงพาณิชย์ให้ใบอนุญาต ABAT ส่งออกและขาย black mass รีไซเคิลได้สูงสุด $100M หลังข้อจำกัดการส่งออกของรัฐบาลกลางบังคับให้ต้องเก็บไว้ในโรงงาน แต่หุ้นยังร่วงจาก ~$1.57 (15 ต.ค.) ถึง ~$1.29 (26 ต.ค.) โดยไม่พบข่าวลบของบริษัท — น่าจะเป็นแรงขายตาม momentum ในตลาด small-cap ที่อ่อน อาจมีการขายผ่าน ATM ภายใต้ shelf $250M ที่ยื่น 18 ก.ย. ด้วย (ยังไม่ยืนยัน) survival ไม่ติดธง: ปิด FY26 ด้วยเงินสด $49.5M ไม่มีหนี้ระยะยาว เทียบ burn $24.2M ต่อปี (~2 ปีที่อัตรานี้) แต่ยังไม่มีตัวเลข Q1 FY27 และ shelf คือแผนหาเงินสร้าง Tonopah Flats จุดพิสูจน์ถัดไปคืองบ Q1 FY2027 (คาดกลางถึงปลาย พ.ย. ยังไม่ประกาศวัน): รายได้รีไซเคิลและยอดขายส่งออกแรก ผลตอบแทน median ของ turbo ณ หลัง catalyst คือ -10.6% (n=69) ให้รอโซนย่อ แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น
